Leverages an understanding of the technology landscape along with knowledge of organizational functions (HR, Finance & Accounting, Procurement, etc.) to provide functional leadership through all phases of an engagement or project. Understands client requirements at a macro level and translates those requirements by defining the business capabilities to support the business functions. Aligns those business capabilities to business processes and identifies technology solutions to support them.

The Functional Architect is typically responsible for:

  • Leading to-be business process workshops with the client
  • Brokering compromise between solution design and operational strategy to minimize custom development
  • Mapping business requirements to process flows
  • Identifying and documenting project-specific processes and functional gaps
  • Managing execution of unit, integration and user acceptance testing
  • Reporting functional area progress to the Solution Architect
